nextReadySlice.title: Manifest schema validation tests
failingProof: A failing proof shows the approved manifest envelope or hosted fixture artifacts can drift from their intended machine-readable schema without deterministic validation feedback.
A failing proof shows snapshots alone do not enforce required manifest fields, versioning, and section/operation shape for downstream tooling.
nextReadySlice.reviewGate: Stop again for review before broader hosted/tooling inspection work if schema validation changes the approved manifest contract or reveals contract drift that needs a design decision.
